title: BrUMaRe: Brillouin-zone Utilities for Materials Research
description: Unified, browser-native and command-line post-processing of CASTEP, VASP, SIESTA, Quantum ESPRESSO and ORCA calculations: band structures, densities of states, band-gap corrections, effective masses, point defects, thermodynamics, charge densities, Voronoi and Bader partitions, cross-code comparison and automatic citation.
